claims: NASA is targeting a launch window for the Artemis II mission from April 1 to April 6, 2026.
The Artemis II mission was delayed from 2025 due to technical assessments.
The Artemis II mission will send four astronauts around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission has returned to launch pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center for final preparations.
The first launch attempt for the Artemis II mission is set for April 1, 2026.
The launch window for the Artemis II mission is April 1–6, 2026, with daily opportunities.
The first launch opportunity for the Artemis II mission is slated for 6:24 p.m. Eastern on April 1, 2026.
The backup window for the Artemis II mission is April 30, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission will test systems in deep space.
